title: Seven Children Group Portrait Outdoors, 1959 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges depicting seven children and teenagers posed outdoors on a sunlit dirt road or path. The group features five boys and two girls of varying ages, dressed in typical late 1950s casual and play attire, including striped t-shirts, polo shirts, jeans, shorts, and a white summer dress. In the background stands a stucco building, lush foliage, a telephone pole, and a low white picket fence on the right. A date stamp along the right border reads '• JUL • 59'.
